subject: Meet Forté. Compare the mattresses. Talk through the options.
preheader: Craig Gorman joins us in Brighton East on 21 October. Practical OT training, discussion and 2 CPD points.
trialFooterText: Sleep Choice covers the seven-night in-home trial at no cost to the participant.
intro: If you recommend beds and mattresses, this is a morning worth making room for.

Join Craig Gorman from Forté Healthcare and the Sleep Choice team in Brighton East on Wednesday 21 October. Explore static, hybrid and powered support surfaces, discuss their clinical applications and ask questions directly.
sectionTitle: Meet the range. Meet the people behind it.
body: The session brings together pressure care, mattress selection and practical applications across community, aged care and acute settings. There’s time for discussion, not just a presentation to sit through.

We’re excited about what our close relationship with Forté makes possible for OTs and their clients. We’ll also cover Sleep Choice’s seven-night home trials, including comfort, positioning, transfers and usability in the client’s own environment.

Come along yourself, or share the invitation with an OT colleague who would find it useful. It’s a practical opportunity for clinicians building their mattress prescription experience, with experienced OTs welcome too.
detail: In-person OT training · Craig Gorman · 2 CPD points
